channel.title: The Paediatric Video Journal
channel.description: Free, open-access videos on research, innovations and expert insights in paediatrics and child health, from critical care and neonatology to medicines.

item.title: ICP monitoring in paediatric traumatic brain injury
item.description: A ten-year single-centre review of intracranial pressure monitoring in severe childhood brain injury, and why multicentre research is needed.

item.title: Transition from PICU to adult critical care
item.description: How adult services can prepare to receive young people from paediatric intensive care, and why young people and families should shape the plan.

item.title: Recognising deterioration before PICU admission
item.description: A two-cycle audit of how deterioration is recognised and escalated before unplanned PICU admission, and what it means for an outreach service.

item.title: A parent’s perspective on shaping critical-care research
item.description: How a parent contributes lived experience through patient and public involvement to help shape paediatric critical-care research.

item.title: Data, AI and clinical decision support in PICU
item.description: How PICU data repositories and decision-support tools could help clinicians weigh uncertainty while supporting, not replacing, clinical judgement.

item.title: What makes paediatric critical care trials succeed?
item.description: The collaborative culture, methodology and data quality behind the UK's randomised trials in paediatric critical care.

item.title: Oncology outcomes in PICU: trends and future research
item.description: Long-term PICANet trends in oncology admissions to intensive care, how to interpret them, and plans for the Care PICU study.

item.title: Shared adult and paediatric expertise in adolescent trauma
item.description: Why adolescent major trauma care benefits from combining adult and paediatric expertise, including safeguarding and support through recovery.

item.title: Reducing low-value care in paediatric ICU
item.description: A Delphi study of low-value PICU practices such as routine blood sampling and fasting, and why questioning routine care matters.

item.title: Precision medicine in intensive care
item.description: How biomarkers could identify patients with different biological responses to critical illness and help design trials across adult and paediatric care.

item.title: Acute liver failure: supporting recovery without transplant
item.description: How critical care can support some children with acute liver failure to recover without transplant, from treating the cause to extracorporeal therapies.

item.title: Caring for teenagers after major trauma
item.description: Why care for teenagers after major trauma should look beyond the injury to safeguarding, psychosocial support, family involvement and recovery.

item.title: Understanding extubation failure in children
item.description: PhD research using PICANet data on why some children need further breathing support after extubation, and the limits of prediction.

item.title: Onc Around the Clock: timing of oncology PICU admissions
item.description: How admission patterns and mortality for unplanned oncology PICU admissions vary by time of day, and what the data can and cannot show.

item.title: Reducing delays in ventilation weaning in PICU
item.description: A retrospective audit of delays in ventilation weaning in PICU and how a checklist or electronic-record dashboard could help teams.

item.title: Lessons from Grenfell: supporting healthcare staff wellbeing
item.description: Reflections on leading an emergency department response to a major incident and what it taught about supporting healthcare staff wellbeing.

item.title: Transition to adult care: The Inbetweeners
item.description: Findings and recommendations from a national study of transition to adult services for young people with complex conditions, and progress since.

item.title: Young people shaping critical-care research
item.description: Why young people should have a voice in critical-care research, from a former PICU patient's experience of taking part.

item.title: How paediatric ARDS research differs from adult evidence
item.description: Why adult findings on acute respiratory distress syndrome cannot simply be applied to children, and the role of precision medicine in future studies.

item.title: Learning from every child: the PIVOTAL platform trial
item.description: How a Bayesian adaptive platform trial tests sedation, fluid and transfusion questions together and learns from every child admitted.

item.title: Bedside resuscitation teaching in PICU
item.description: A quality-improvement project using short tea-trolley sessions to refresh resuscitation skills at the bedside in a busy PICU.

item.title: Understanding early unplanned PICU readmission
item.description: A retrospective study of unplanned PICU readmission within 48 hours of discharge and what it suggests about the safety of care transitions.

item.title: Adaptive platform trials and PIVOTAL
item.description: How adaptive platform trials such as PIVOTAL can test several interventions at once and generate evidence for critically ill children faster.

item.title: Rethinking gastric residual monitoring in PICU
item.description: What the GASTRIC-PICU trial asks about routine gastric residual monitoring during enteral feeding and the cost of unquestioned practice.

item.title: PICUlearn: building a paediatric intensive care learning community
item.description: How PICUlearn gathers teaching, research updates, webinars and guidance in one online learning community for the PICU team, especially trainees.

item.title: Supporting allied health professionals across PCCS
item.description: The contribution of allied health professionals to paediatric critical care and how PCCS events and membership can support their network.

item.title: Swallow Vision: paediatric laryngeal ultrasound
item.description: How speech and language therapists are testing bedside laryngeal ultrasound to assess vocal fold movement, sucking and swallowing in infants.

item.title: Towards personalised ventilation in PICU
item.description: A research programme using protein biomarkers, lung ultrasound and health-record data to move towards more personalised breathing support.

item.title: Paediatric organ donation: the PCCS and NHSBT partnership
item.description: How PCCS and NHS Blood and Transplant are working together on a shared strategy for paediatric and neonatal organ donation within end-of-life care.

item.title: Strengthening educator provision in paediatric critical care
item.description: Research recommendations on clarifying educator roles and planning education provision in district general hospitals as standards are revised.

item.title: Children’s medical treatment and the role of the courts
item.description: How courts approach serious medical-treatment cases involving children, including best interests, differing views and clinician anonymity.

item.title: Exploring central-line patency and saline practice
item.description: A quality-improvement project comparing normal and heparinised saline for central-line patency, and why a provisional trial was stopped.

item.title: Building a long-term nursing career in PICU
item.description: The career paths open to PICU nurses through clinical practice, research, education and leadership, within and beyond paediatric critical care.

item.title: Medical students on PCCS and traumatic brain injury research
item.description: Two students describe attending PCCS and presenting a retrospective project on intracranial pressure monitoring in children with brain injury.

item.title: Making Martha's Rule equitable
item.description: A regional escalation route piloted by the North Thames network to give children in district general hospitals fairer access to Martha's Rule.

item.title: Connecting the PCCS community through communication
item.description: How PCCS communications aim to connect members, share news and opportunities, and support the wider interests of the specialty.

item.title: Giving back to paediatric critical care
item.description: Why a family's experience of paediatric intensive care led to a commitment to supporting conferences and education for the critical-care community.

item.title: Care closer to home: transport and sustainability
item.description: A review of a paediatric transport service looking at ambulance mileage, family travel distances and environmental impact after GIRFT recommendations.

item.title: Why population data matter in paediatric critical care
item.description: How population-level data such as PICANet can reveal problems earlier and guide research priorities in paediatric critical care.

item.title: Caring for children with complex critical illness
item.description: UK mixed-methods work on how children with complex critical illness are defined, supported and cared for by multidisciplinary teams.
